content:
Elaine M: Quick sync — Databridge integrator co-marketing. Target joint launch week 4/15. Need owners for: launch post, benchmark narrative, webinar, inbound lead routing, and messaging A/B tests. Who can pick what? :rocket:
Sam P: I can own the webinar org + run of show. Thinking 60min: 30m demo (integration highlight), 20m benchmark results, 10m Q&A. Proposed dates: 4/14 or 4/16. Prefer 4/16 PST.
Ben S: I'll take inbound lead routing and SLA for MQLs. Quick routing sketch:
```yaml
source: databridge_marketplace
tag: partner_databridge
priority: high
route_to: sales_eng_queue
notify: ben.sales@redwood.ai
followup_timing: 30m
```
Will add webhook to our CRM and set auto-assign.
Aria G: Happy to own the benchmark narrative + data. Suggest we focus on two slices: 
- latency @ 1k reqs/min (p95, cost/token)
- end-to-end integration time (dev-minutes to prod with our SDK)
Also propose a short reproducible script for partners to run.
Elaine M: Perfect. For the launch post we should emphasize: ease of embed, performance wins, and marketplace listing steps. Draft angle: "Ship LLM features faster: Databridge + Redwood Inference". Will iterate headlines.
Sam P: Webinar speakers: suggest Elaine (marketing intro), Aria (benchmarks), Sam P (integration demo), Databridge engineer (live Q&A). I can handle invites + registration page. Need slide draft by 4/7.
Ben S: Routing note — add an email triage rule for free-trial signups from the marketplace: if trial_plan==enterprise then escalate to AMs. Also will add utm parsing.
Aria G: For the benchmark, prelim metric targets: 
- 30% lower per-token cost with smart batching/cache
- p95 latency under 450ms at 1k rps
I'll assemble graphs and a reproducible Colab.
Elaine M: Messaging A/B test ideas (two headline variants):
A) "Cut LLM latency, not corners: Databridge + Redwood"
B) "Deploy integrations in hours — benchmarked at scale"
We'll A/B on blog header + webinar subject line.
Sam P: Registration fields: company, role, expected use-case, cloud provider. Add checkbox "I'm evaluating Dedicated/Private" to route to enterprise SDR.
Ben S: I'll create two inbound queues: partner_marketplace and partner_enterprise. Auto-tagging logic will be on the webhook. Also setting SLA: reply within 1 business day for partner_marketplace leads.
Elaine M: Content plan timeline:
- 4/2: draft blog + bench outline
- 4/7: slides + webinar page live
- 4/10: dry run with partner
- 4/15-4/16: launch + webinar
Can everyone confirm items by EOD tomorrow?
Sam P: Confirmed. I'll attach registration link once page is live.
Ben S: Confirmed, will push routing webhook and test payloads today.
Aria G: Confirmed, will upload draft benchmark figures to the shared drive by EOD.
LaunchBot: Automated note: registration page stub created at https://redwood.ai/webinars/databridge-stub (private). :robot_face:
Elaine M: Thanks team — once drafts are in, I'll collect feedback and publish PR to the partner playbook. Also cc @legal for a quick review on quotes + partner logo usage.
Sam P: Will schedule the dry run with Databridge engineering for 4/10.
Ben S: Posting test payload example (short):
```json
{
  "email": "test+databridge@acme.com",
  "source": "databridge_marketplace",
  "plan": "trial"
}
```
Aria G: One ask for the partner: can they provide a sample dataset (anonymized) so benchmarks are realistic? I'll send a request.
Elaine M: Awesome. If no blockers, we meet next week same thread for status. :sparkles:
